user.title: Austrian tariff profile
user.description: Select the grid area and supply type. EEG (Erneuerbare-Energie-Gemeinschaft) tariffs apply only to allocated community energy, with Elektrizitätsabgabe automatically set to zero. Create a separate regular grid profile for residual supply. Scope: grid level 7, non-metered capacity, single tariff.
